name: Sayantan Ghosal
bio: Sayantan Ghosal is an Indian film director primarily associated with the Bengali movie industry. He has directed movies like Jawker Dhan, Sagardwiper Jawker Dhan, Satyanweshi Byomkesh and many more. He also directed Byomkesh S1-S3 for Hoichoi and the web series, Lalbazaar, streaming on ZEE5.

credits.overview: A young woman embarks on a journey to London, hoping to reunite with her estranged lover, but as betrayal and difficult choices unfold, she discovers an unexpected connection that changes everything.

credits.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
credits.overview: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

credits.overview: A young Bengali detective in London delves into a century-old legend of a deadly hound, uncovering dark secrets and unexpected suspects in a race to solve the mystery before it claims another life.

credits.title: Alinagarer Golokdhadha
credits.overview: Alinagarer Golokdhadha is an adventure mystery film, released on 20 April 2018, directed by Sayanton Ghosal, produced by Rutrum Juin, starring Anirban Bhattacharya and Parno Mittra in lead roles. It is film collaboration for a Bengali movie between Eros International and Champion Movies.
